name: QuietJar
description: An embeddable donation button built around goals that end. Set a goal for a real cost, supporters cover it in a couple of taps on your own site, and the button steps aside until the next goal.
featureList: Monthly or one-off goals with a progress bar that hide the button once met
On-page checkout with wallet payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay), cards, and iDEAL
Steps back for a while after someone donates, so supporters are not asked again
Dynamic images for READMEs and newsletters that follow goal progress
